purpose: numerical sampler engineering gate, not predictive validation

K03_savings.adapter: three identical paired costs 1 versus 0.6; demand 1000/2000; full routing; capture scenario losses before CVaR

finite_breach.adapter: one paired unit; incumbent latency 100, candidate latency 200, routing share 0.04, strict latency limit 150; capture per-scenario latency before quantile

aggregate_precision_check: sum of squared atom-frequency errors at N=10000 must be less than at prefix N=1000, over both laws and all seeds
rerun_policy: No seed selection or rerunning failed seeds to obtain a pass. Candidate changes require a new identified run; retain prior results.
